Python根包allinluna 2.0.0-rc.7含DSH Cordis适配allinflash；根研究条目真实类型infrastructure，非将子包当整仓身份。

#### 启动与依赖

| 条件 | 必需范围 | 作用 | 缺失/边界 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Python >=3.11/allinluna CLI | 核心 | CLI与SQLite事实层 | 路径不存在时适配返回安装提示 |
| 文件DB及迁移权限 | 持久运行 | Run、任务、回执与日志 | SQLite事务不包远端child |
| DSH tools/subagents | All in Flash | 四工具及startContinuable | provider实际能力须宿主验收 |
| 完整持久HostAction | relay | 冻结prompt/opcode/hash | next-actions预览目前不满足 |
| Task合同/ownership/spec | 可靠交付 | 依赖和验收边界 | 声明错误不能自动变安全 |
| 模型/工具/人工决策 | 实际工作 | 独立执行与命令信任批准 | 费用和并发资源未测 |

根2.0.0-rc.7，DSH文档安装All in Flash 0.2.0；制品未执行验收。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q04](#research-q04)

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金/资源 | 人工投入 | 未知与限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次 | Python/DSH包、DB和环境存储 | 配专用profile、合同/spec/ownership | 两生态版本/制品未验收 |
| 持续 | 并行模型/工具、SQLite/工件 | 调度、审批、依赖与handoff复核 | 不保证token或墙钟节省 |
| 失败 | 重试可能重复child/模型费用 | 对账动作/回执/租约和外部结果 | timeout失败不是无副作用 |
| 退出 | 保留DB/工件 | 撤适配并检查活动child | 无自动回滚远端操作保证 |

总人工时间与单位合格任务成本待比较。[Q04](#research-q04)
当前观察。DSH维护者先对齐next-actions/dispatch与relay，并验证创建后入库失败、重放与活动child对账；再以双Task副本对照单会话子Agent，业务验收与总成本不改善则回原工作方式。保留DB/工件并逐项处理活动child，不靠暂停等同终止。[Q05](#research-q05)

#### 效果

| 项目 | 源码支持 | 未证实/反证 |
|---|---|---|
| 持久协调 | SQLite事务与outbox | 不跨远端动作原子提交 |
| 有条件并行 | 依赖/ownership/资源slot | 未测吞吐或冲突避免效果 |
| 独立验收 | typed spec、信任门、done_when覆盖 | spec不充分仍可漏业务错误 |
| DSH转交 | 完整动作到child/receipt | next-actions目前只读摘要不满足relay |
| 恢复 | DB去重/回执事实 | 创建前无同键保证，重复child未实测 |

本轮仅源码机制，不把作者效果图/测试数量当运行结果。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03)
SQLite外层事务与意图/回执分离、验证程序不从自然语言自动变shell是明确工程设计。DSH预览/派发合同漂移及物理创建到入库间隙显示跨层接线仍需验收；RLock/ownership不等同多租户或全局fencing。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) [Q04](#research-q04)
将任务依赖、资源/ownership调度、意图/回执和done_when的独立验证组织为持久编排事实，避免只凭模型叙述合并结果。此结构可解释跨会话交接，但实际净效率尚无同任务证据。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q03](#research-q03) [Q04](#research-q04)
当前DSH next_actions调用只读preview别名，缺relay所需完整字段，声明路径不闭合；relay又先物理创建child后入库回执，失败重试不由后置去重保证唯一创建。上下文和ownership不是安全隔离，receipt/hash不是业务验收。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03)
可研究消费持久动作、创建前认领和创建后对账的DSH派发协议，中间失败保留unknown/reconcile；先核对provider幂等/查询能力，再在三个崩溃点重放检验实际child数与恢复成本，不以数据库去重替代外部效果保证。[Q05](#research-q05)

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)store与verification相对单会话临时子Agent增加持久Task/回执/验收层，novelty取50%（18），超过25%入口包装因工作边界和状态权威变化，未到75%因DAG/SQLite/租约/证据是成熟组合且DSH闭环有错配。[Q03](#research-q03)scheduler:690-749先租约/意图再宿主回执，mechanism取50%（15），高于25%因控制依赖/资源/派发取舍，未到75%因[Q02](#research-q02)创建后入库间隙和适配断链不解决端到端副作用。[Q04](#research-q04)evidence:190-242及435-475将声明/程序/证据分开，transferability取50%（10），超过25%因typed契约可移到其他任务，未到75%因跨宿主效果和合同充分性未验。[Q02](#research-q02)薄DSH插件统一CLI事实权威有局部去重复价值，simplification取25%（4），高于零因四工具不另写状态机，未到50%因Python/JS协议已漂移且协调复杂度仍显著。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)顶层任务/局部worker及[Q03](#research-q03)依赖出口改变跨域分工与交接，workflow取50%（18），高于25%因不只是更多spawn入口，未到75%因真实任务收益及DSH默认闭环未验。[Q04](#research-q04)spec/证据覆盖done_when使交付单元从聊天done变合同工件，delivery取50%（15），超过25%文本汇总，未到75%因验收充分性和真实交付未验证。[Q02](#research-q02)DSH四工具将Python编排暴露给宿主用户，reach取25%（5），超过零有实际adapter，未到50%因安装两生态且默认取动作错配，未证明新群体进入。[Q03](#research-q03)slot/backlog按就绪依赖组织并发资源，economics取25%（4），高于零因资源配给结构可见，未到50%因未测单位合格任务成本，重复child风险和协调费用可抵消节省。

recommendation.reason: 需要跨域任务持久协调的维护者应先观察并修正DSH动作接口再准备副本验证。它比单会话临时子Agent多出持久依赖、资源与独立验收结构，但next-actions目前返回不可转交预览且创建后回执失败不能盲重试。若动作、child和证据无法对账，或协调成本超过原方案，就回原宿主任务组织并明确处置活动child，保留DB和工件。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)README:23-49给跨域目标与长上下文/依赖交接摩擦，[Q03](#research-q03)实际依赖/导出调度回应这一流程，取75%（23），超过50%泛用途因失败阻塞和验收责任清楚；未到100%因需求持续性和真实团队承担配置成本无直接数据。

advantage.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03)store:84-115与scheduler:690-749、[Q04](#research-q04)evidence:435-475相对聊天进度表提供结构化交接/验证，取50%（13），超过25%入口便利因状态权威和验收单位改变；未到75%因[Q02](#research-q02)DSH路径断链及重复物理效果风险，业务净改善没有实测。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)index:181-190和cli:452-469直接反映默认取动作/relay矛盾，核心DSH试用链不能闭合，取25%（6），高于零因持久调度和验证主张有固定完整材料、并非全部被反驳；未到50%因主要采用路径仍缺无矛盾接线与宿主运行证据，源码13不是默认。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)双运行时/profile/DB/spec维护与[Q02](#research-q02)创建后失败对账由用户承担，取25%（5），高于零因专用profile与DB/工件可保留、可回原方案；未到50%因退出活动child/重放未知及协议修复仍重要缺口，尚不能把可暂停当低成本恢复。

publication.summaries.text: 以持久TaskGraph、资源调度、宿主动作回执和独立验收组织跨会话任务，包含DSH适配。

研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：顶层任务编排、持久调度与验收如何接线，DSH路径能否闭环？ ### Q01 · 顶层任务层给谁解决什么，根条目是否普通插件？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 根组件是Python持久编排基础设施，含Codex/DSH适配，不能只按子目录Cordis插件将整个项目叫普通插件。pyproject提供allinluna CLI与Python >=3.11要求，DSH子包All in Flash导出四个工具并要求subagents服务。场景是涉及前后端、迁移、测试和文档的大目标：一个长会话持有所有日志时，任务阻塞、交接与验收容易混在一起；作者提出顶层Task拥有独立目标、上下文、依赖、状态和结果边界，局部仍可用WorkUnit/subagent。 相对只在一个会话里临时spawn子Agent，代码增量是SQLite事实层、全局TaskGraph调度、资源/ownership租约、冻结host动作与回执、独立VerificationSpec和handoff证据。这改变工作与验收组织，而非提高模型本身推理能力。独立上下文不等于独立OS进程、工作树或安全租户；DSH具体使用startContinuable，是宿主的持续child入口，产品所称top-level是本系统的编排语义，不自动等同另一个产品的用户顶层聊天。 合格结果是所有约定工件/检查有可追溯证据、依赖正确交接且能解释重启/未知执行状态，不是“更多任务并发”或模型说done。作者主张的减少上下文污染/提高效率须同任务比较，目前未验证。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:23-49](https://github.com/zenx0x/allinluna/blob/b471713089d8352c1c97e05fe3d25907a4164b1a/README.md#L23-L49) 作者说明长任务上下文摩擦，不视为用户实测。

\n\n> **Stop running an entire project inside one AI conversation.**\n\nGive All in Luna one big goal.\n\nIt turns the work into independent top-level tasks: **run what can run in parallel, wait only on real dependencies, keep each task's context separate, and bring the results back together.**\n\nEach task can still use its own subagents, tools, Skills, or MCPs.\n\n**Parallel across tasks. \n \n

\n\n---\n\n## Why does this exist?\n\nSmall AI coding tasks are easy.\n\nThe hard part looks more like this:\n\n> “Refactor authentication end to end, including the backend, frontend, migration, tests, and documentation.”\n\nAt first, everything is fine.\n\nThen the agent reads files, edits code, runs tests, starts subagents, handles failures, reads more files, and keeps pushing more execution detail back into the same conversation.\n\nAfter enough turns, familiar problems appear:\n\n- the context keeps growing;\n- unrelated work starts contaminating other work;\n- earlier constraints become easier to forget;\n- one local blocker stalls the whole flow;\n- subagent results become harder to manage;\n- a new conversation has to reconstruct what really happened;\n- the agent says “done,” but the outcome may not actually be complete.\n\n**All in Luna starts from one simple idea: one conversation should not have to carry an entire project.**\n\n

\n \n

\n\n---\n\n## One more layer above subagents\n\nA typical agent workflow looks like this:\n\n```text\nYou\n │\n ▼\nMain Agent\n ├─ subagent\n ├─ subagent\n └─ subagent\n```\n\nAll in Luna adds a real **Top-level Task** layer above local workers:\n\n```text\nYou\n │\n ▼\nAll in Luna\n │\n ├─ Top-level Task A\n │ ├─ local work\n │ └─ subagents / tools / Skills\n │\n ├─ Top-level Task B\n │ ├─ local work\n │ └─ subagents / tools / MCPs\n │\n └─ Top-level Task C\n └─ waits only when it actually depends on A\n```\n\n**A Top-level Task is not just another subagent.**\n\nIt is an independent work domain with its own goal, context, dependencies, working state, local execution process, and result boundary.\n\nA subagent is a local worker a Task may use when that Task needs to split its own work further.\n\n> **All in Luna does not replace subagents. It gives them a better place to live.**\n\n---\n\n# What you get\n\n## 1. Real top-level tasks\n\nA large goal can become independent work domains instead of temporary chat branches.\n\nFor example:\n\n```text\nAdd billing to this app\n\n├─ Billing backend\n├─ Checkout UI\n├─ Database migration\n├─ Integration tests\n└─ Documentation\n```\n\nEach task can move independently, wait on dependencies, produce results, and keep its own working context.\n\n## 2. Parallel when possible\n\nIndependent work does not need to queue behind unrelated work.\n\n```text\nBilling backend ● running\nCheckout UI ● running\nDocumentation ● running\nDatabase migration ○ waiting for schema\nIntegration tests ○ waiting for backend\n```\n\n**One blocked task doesn't freeze unrelated work.**\n\n## 3. Separate working contexts\n\nBackend debugging does not need to share one giant context with frontend changes, test logs, documentation, and release work.\n\nYour main conversation should mostly see:\n\n```text\n✓ what is done\n● what is running\n○ what is waiting\n! what needs your decision\n```\n\nFile reads, terminal output, test logs, diffs, and implementation detail can stay with the Task that produced them.\n\n**Your main conversation does not need to become the project's log file.**\n\n## 4. Recursive local workers\n\nA Top-level Task can still split into WorkUnits or use local subagents when it is complex on its own.\n\n```text\nBackend Task\n ├─ API\n ├─ database changes\n ├─ tests\n └─ migration checks\n```\n\nLocal complexity stays local.\n\n**Parallel across tasks. Recursive inside tasks.**\n\n## 5.
